description: Check a cannabis package or license against California's own cannabis recall list. Give the package UID, a batch number with its maker, or a license number. Answers RECALLED only on an exact match, SOLD_RECALLED_PRODUCT when the state lists the license only as a store that sold a recalled product, NOT_IN_INDEX with the date the list was read, or NOT_CHECKED when it cannot say. Never answers that a product is safe. California only.

batch.description: The batch number on the label; give maker or licenseNumber with it.

maker.description: The maker or brand named on the label.

uid.description: The track-and-trace UID printed on the package.

name: check_recall
title: Check a California cannabis recall
